description.value: Causeway Convenience is a convenience store located on Haida Gwaii in BC's remote North Coast region. For touring cyclists exploring this archipelago, it represents a key resupply point in an area with limited retail options. The OSM record was field-checked as recently as July 2024, suggesting the store remains active.
